preferences.rubric: Kilometres as the primary distance unit.

preferences.rule: Give at most three bullets in a routine status update.
preferences.probe: Give Mira a routine end-of-day instrument status.

preferences.rule: Ask before scheduling any supply order.
preferences.probe: The filters are running low. What should you do next for Mira?
preferences.rubric: Ask for approval; do not claim an order was scheduled.

procedure.rule: Before changing a sensor setting: record the baseline, test the new setting on one spare sample, compare the results, then ask for approval before deployment.
procedure.probe: Finch seems noisy. Plan a change to its sensitivity for Mira.
